text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "do a shut / no shut on the port",
    "avoid": [
      "sfp.replace",
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Don't swap the optic again and don't reboot the node. Just do a shut / no shut on the port.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Yes, it came back! Traffic is flowing now and counters are going up nicely. Thanks! :)",
    "about_entity": "TRN-063",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable rule for when a link is up with zero counters after an SFP swap on older units: bounce the port instead of swapping the SFP again or rebooting."
}
